name: Deva Zealot

alignment.name: Unaligned
alignment.description:
Unaligned creatures don’t actively seek to harm others or wish them ill. But such creatures also don’t go out of their way to put themselves at risk without some hope for reward. They support law and order when doing so benefits them. They value their own freedom, without worrying too much about protecting the freedom of others.
	A few unaligned people, and most unaligned deities, aren’t undecided about alignment. Rather, they’ve chosen not to choose, either because they see the benefits of both good and evil or because they see themselves as above the concerns of morality. The Raven Queen and her devotees fall into the latter camp, believing that moral choices are irrelevant to their mission, since death comes to all creatures regardless of alignment.

items.name: Leather Armor
items.description:
Leather armor is sturdier than cloth armor. It protects vital areas with multiple layers of boiled-leather plates, while covering the limbs with supple leather that provides a small amount of protection.
	Magic appears at higher item levels, and grants higher armor bonuses than its mundane counterparts. Leather armor grants +3 AC at levels 16-25, and +4 AC at levels 26-30.

items.name: Falchion
items.description: A falchion features a long, wide blade that bends in a curve, similar to that of a scimitar.

description: This is the size of a typical human and serves as a standard in the game. This category has no special rules.

traits.name: Skirmish
traits.details: If a deva zealot ends its move at least 4 squares from the square where it started the move, its attacks deal 1d6 extra radiant damage until the start of its next turn.

effect.description: The deva zealot shifts half its speed and makes one falchion attack against each enemy within reach during the move

The deva zealot gains concealment until the start of its next turn, and any other square within 6 squares of the zealot is illuminated by bright light. Any square within 12 squares of the zealot is illuminated by dim light.

powers.name: Radiant Retribution
powers.trigger: when an enemy hits the deva zealot on the zealot’s turn

effect.description: The triggering enemy takes half the attack’s damage as radiant damage.

powers.name: Memory of A Thousand Lifetimes
powers.trigger: when the deva zealot makes an attack roll, a skill check, or an ability check and dislikes the result

effect.description: The zealot adds 1d6 to the triggering roll.
